title: SHARP: Social Harm Analysis via Risk Profiles for Measuring Inequities in Large Language Models
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark measured social harm, with one of its four dimensions being 'bias'. Within the bias dimension, 'religion' was included as one of several protected categories to assess for biased content, including the breadth, intensity, and amplification of bias.
findings: The paper does not report specific findings related to religion. The results are aggregated at the level of the four primary harm dimensions (bias, fairness, ethics, epistemic reliability). While 'religion' was a category measured within the 'bias' dimension, the analysis does not break down the bias results by specific demographic categories.
references: Alok Abhishek, Lisa Erickson, and Tushar Bandopadhyay. Beats: Bias evaluation and assessment test suite for large language models, 2025. URL https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.24310.
